RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither the successful candidate’s sex nor the announcement establishes unfairness; her relevant experience and interview performance may have distinguished her.

Focus on the selection process: follow up your request and ask for the assessment criteria, your scores, and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate.

Panel-composition requirements, response deadlines and appeal rights vary by jurisdiction. Check these promptly with your union or an employment adviser; don’t assume your unanswered request pauses any appeal deadline. Raise panel composition if a relevant rule requires it—not as an unsupported allegation of bias.
